last_summary: The v1 reference step is supported as forming a patty with a round metal ring mold and lifting the mold away. The v2 fine observation at 168.001-183.001 contains the same functional transition: meat compacted in a round metal ring mold and the mold lifted away to reveal a formed patty. Later v2 patty-handling observations lack a visible lifted mold and are not preferred equivalents.
